notes.en: Meet MatchApp TV Ai: a new rounded header, custom lettering, visible phone poster backgrounds and reliable update feedback. Stability fixes: smoother phone scrolling, corrected poster identities, reliable local cover fallbacks, recovery from damaged browser caches, and synchronized matching filters. Empty exact searches no longer use credits or silently change your choices. Your current layout, themes and Kids safety rules are preserved.
